name: akbun-utils
description: Utility helpers — daily recap from iCalendar (.ics) data and other small productivity tools

interface.shortDescription: Utility skills — daily recap from iCalendar (.ics) data
interface.longDescription: Small utility skills for everyday productivity. Includes a daily recap skill that reads the built-in macOS Calendar or iCalendar (.ics) data directly, collects today's events from 00:00 to 23:30, and summarizes what happened today as a short numbered list in a terse, slide-style format.
defaultPrompt: 오늘 내 캘린더(.ics)로 오늘 뭐 했는지 정리해줘: <ICS_PATH_OR_URL>
아이캘린더 데이터로 오늘 하루 recap 만들어줘
